views.desc_en: low wide shot near the grass from the path in from the wood, the March Hare's house towering over the lens with its ear-shaped chimneys and fur-like thatch, the long table in front
eye-level medium shot from the big arm-chair straight down the length of the crowded table to the sitters' corner at the far end
eye-level medium reverse from the sitters' corner back along the table to the big arm-chair at the other end
eye-level wide shot from the stone well-head across the sunlit grass to the long tea-table in the shade of the horse-chestnut, the wood's edge behind
high oblique wide shot from the house doorstep looking down over the whole long table and its chairs toward the open grass
eye-level close shot from the table on the face of the tall-case clock by the door, its hands stopped at six o'clock
eye-level detail from beside the horse-chestnut trunk across the used teacups, teapots and bread-and-butter on the stained cloth
low-angle medium shot from the table looking up past the thatch eaves to the two ear-shaped chimneys and the round gable window
eye-level medium shot from beside the tall-case clock across the grass to the stone well-head at the yard's edge

calibration_note_en: Coordinates re-read from the rendered image 2026-09-23. The horse-chestnut came out as a small young tree at the table's west end, not a great spreading crown, so the table sits in open sun and not in shade. The chimney reads as one stack with two round pots (the ear shape is not readable from above). The table measures about 10.7 m, not 7 m.

checklist.camera_orthographic: near-nadir; the house front shows a thin strip of its facade below the eave
